entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person in the front row who has short light-brown hair, wears a black top, light-green over-ear headphones, and a dark two-shoulder safety harness, and faces away from the camera.

entities.name: aircraft cockpit
entities.identification: The light-colored cockpit interior walls, dark window frames, transparent overhead window, and front instrument panel surrounding Person A.

entities.name: front-row seat
entities.identification: The front-row seat behind Person A, with the edge of its light gray-beige cushion visible slightly left of the bottom edge of the frame.

entities.name: field
entities.identification: The adjacent plots of field outside the windows, predominantly yellowish brown with some light green.

entities.name: forest belt
entities.identification: The dark green-gray strips and patches of woodland with winding edges between the plots of field.

entities.name: field road
entities.identification: The narrow, light-colored sections of field road that are partially discernible between the plots of field outside the windows.

entities.name: building complex
entities.identification: The scattered groups of buildings outside the windows, visible mainly by their light-colored roofs.

entities.name: pond surface
entities.identification: The small turquoise-green pond surface with a light-colored bank among the fields.
